employee_report.scope: Employee-reported Eurofins group organisation in Ireland under Gilles; not Biomnis; legal employer and policy eligibility unconfirmed
employee_report.note: Reports 12 weeks of fully paid maternity leave (clarified from the initial six-month description), 12 weeks of paid paternity leave, mental health support and learning/training support. Reports no reproductive health benefits, childcare, caregiver leave, adoption support or health insurance. Group senior leadership is 8% women in the 2025 ESG report, earning 2 points; this is a global group governance metric, not an Ireland-only percentage. Equal-pay audit, salary-band transparency and a formal return-to-work programme remain unconfirmed. New reported benefits await policy verification; existing public links do not substantiate these new claims.

evidence_notes.women_leaders: 2025 ESG report, page 124, Table 38: 8% women in group senior leadership (GOC including CEO and Regional Business Line Leaders), 96% scope coverage. Global group metric; not Ireland-only or all management levels.
evidence_notes.organisation_scope: 2022 group directory, page 228, identifies Eurofins Scientific Services (Ireland) Limited as the Ireland Group Service Centre. Historical organisational context only; does not verify current benefit entitlements. Leave, mental health and learning inputs remain employee-reported.
